text:
Iris: quick bring-up note for AtlasLite v0.9 (128d, per-channel int6). Throughput ~1.9x vs fp16 but recall@10 on wiki-holdout slid 0.028 (0.885 -> 0.857). posting for triage.
Noah: thanks. which cohorts? any short-query signal?
Iris: short queries (<=6 tokens) down most, tail cohort also affected. cluster purity -0.03, mean cosine shift ~0.015.
Priya: did you run neighbor-consensus? any anchor flips?
Iris: neighbor-consensus k=10 anchor-flip ~8%. k=1 flips ~4% (so top-1 instability present).
Noah: immediate actions: 1) try index-time L2 normalization 2) run 1k calibration set recalib 3) per-tensor vs per-channel sweep 4) hybrid-anchor (top-16 fp16) smoke.
eval-bot: embed-eval started by @Noah: id=e-9901 metrics=[recall@1,recall@5,recall@10,anchor-flip(k=1,10),cluster-purity] datasets=[wiki-holdout,short,tail]. ETA 25m.
Priya: note: quick normalize sample historically recovers ~1.2% recall. if normalization + recalib recovers >=2% we can consider canary.
Iris: do not promote AtlasLite-int6 to staging yet. Noah to post eval results when done.
Noah: kicking off per-tensor sweep now, will report back in ~30m. :thumbsup:
